shared_conditions: Loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS.

statements.answer_quote: The shortcoming must be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated)
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming must be reported on DA Form 2404 (Equipment Inspection and Maintenance Worksheet) or DA Form 5988-E (automated).

statements.answer_quote: immediately after the PMCS, before corrective action is taken
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming must be reported immediately after the PMCS and before corrective action is taken.

statements.answer_quote: will be recorded in the equipment record
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming will be recorded in the equipment record.

statements.answer_quote: The specified tightening torque for the starter mounting bolts is 40 lb-ft (54 N•m)
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the specified tightening torque for the starter mounting bolts is 40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
